Commencement of Terms; Credits and Allowances
Good Conduct Allowances for Persons Committed Prior to July 1, 1981

law.text: Such credit as any person may have earned pursuant to § 53.1-193 or § 53.1-194 and not forfeited prior to June 24, 1944, shall remain to his credit, unless forfeited as hereinafter provided.
